title: Committed app.bin (2 MB built binary) at the repo root — build artifact ships in the PR
evidence:
diff --git a/app.bin b/app.bin
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..4aaf130
Binary files /dev/null and b/app.bin differ

worktree: -rwxr-xr-x@ 1 moses  staff  2057480  9 Aug 15:47 app.bin
git ls-files | grep -c app.bin -> 1

.gitignore hunk adds only: +tools/raylib-sw/
+bin/
+goldens/_reports/
detail: A 2 MB platform-specific binary is tracked at the root; .gitignore covers bin/ but not app.bin. Bloat + rot risk: the artifact can silently drift from source (CI builds app fresh).
recommended_fix: git rm app.bin, add /app.bin to .gitignore. The CI step 'odin build app' already proves the game compiles; no committed binary is needed.

title: draw_and_reject.dem claims ports + budget rejection classes but the script never triggers them
evidence:
# draw_and_reject.dem — the edit contract, exercised through the real bus:
# valid draws land; every rejection class returns its typed error (E3/E26 +
# span + ports + budget). Terminal-terminal is the 'play the internet' rule.

intents: at 300ms draw_pipe house_c house_d standard -> terminal_to_terminal
at 400ms draw_pipe house_a house_a standard -> self_loop
at 500ms draw_pipe host router narrow -> span_exceeds_tier

data/node_types.json: { "id": "router_mid", ... "port_capacity": 8 }
data/balance.json: "default_budget": 5200
core/run.odin:58-64 fixture spawns the MID router; the script ends with 6 pipes on it (house_a, house_b, host, house_c, house_d, host) and ~$1450 of $5200 spent.
detail: Ports (8-cap router, 6 pipes) and budget ($5200, ~$1450 spend) rejections never fire, so the golden corpus pins only E26/E3/span classes at integration level; the comment misstates coverage.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to list the exercised classes, or add intents that actually hit the 8-port cap and exhaust $5200 (they validate with expect_err -> ports_full / over_budget).

title: Node-health 🟡/🔴 warning surface (Ev_Warning_Raised/Cleared) has zero direct tests; goldens cover it only transitively
detail: Warnings fire inside the goldened surge run (392 raised/383 cleared) and are hashed into T1, so the surface is transitively pinned; thresholds, levels, and clear-on-recovery have no assertion. A broken warning surface ships green.
recommended_fix: Add a crisis unit test (strain/critical thresholds, level values, cleared-on-recovery) and/or a surge demo expect for Ev_Warning_Raised within the surge window.

title: E9 drop-ladder order (Best → Standard → Express) unpinned — Queue_Overflow appears in zero tests
detail: The spec'd shed order across lanes and the newest-first depth bound are asserted nowhere; the flood test checks only direction of harm at one configuration, so the ladder can reorder or drop Express-first with every gate green.
recommended_fix: Flood a dialed pipe past queue_drop_depth and assert drop reasons/order per lane (Best shed before Standard before Express), plus the newest-first convention at the depth boundary.

title: Committed review docs (verification-gap.md, edge-case-hunter.md) grade pre-fix states as current blockers — the verification surface is misstated
evidence:

current tree (same sha): harness/goldens.odin 'if mismatch < 0 { // undecodable or dimension-drifted golden — the pixel tier must fail loudly, never pass on nothing (review r1 blocker)'; harness/replay.odin 'replayed, ok := replay_hashes(log_path, catalogs, u64(man.ticks), false, &fails)'; ci.yml has 'Game builds (the shipped artifact compiles)' -> 'odin build app -out:"$RUNNER_TEMP/packet-plumber"'

empirical at 0118cc0: 'harness replay: 3000 ticks verified against the manifest — bit-for-bit (ODN-11)', 'harness replay: 250 ticks verified against the manifest — bit-for-bit (ODN-11)', 'Finished 40 tests in 198.393ms. All tests were successful.', 'harness: 7 demo(s) green'
